scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nau/domain && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @nau/api" "npm run dev -w @nau/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start -w @nau/api" "npm run start -w @nau/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nau/domain && npm run build -w @nau/api && npm run build -w @nau/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nau/domain && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
